source: a recorded playthrough of Pokemon Red (place names, exits as the player sees them, where they led); no ROM bytes, no graphics

story.goal: Leave the house and walk north out of Pallet Town toward Route 1; Professor Oak will stop you and bring you to his lab.
In Oak's lab, choose a starter Pokemon from the Poke Balls on the table.
Battle your rival in Oak's lab (he challenges you as you try to leave).
Go north through Route 1 to Viridian City and enter the Poke Mart to receive Oak's Parcel.
Bring Oak's Parcel back to Professor Oak in his lab in Pallet Town and talk to him.
Head north from Viridian City through Route 2 and Viridian Forest toward Pewter City.
Defeat Brock, the Pewter City Gym Leader (Rock/Ground). Water, Grass and Fighting moves are strong against him.
Travel east from Pewter City along Route 3 and through Mt. Moon to Route 4 and Cerulean City.
Defeat Misty, the Cerulean City Gym Leader (Water). Electric or Grass moves are strong against her.
Go north across Nugget Bridge (Route 24) and east on Route 25 to Bill's house; help Bill and get the S.S. Ticket.
Go south through Route 5, the Underground Path and Route 6 to Vermilion City; board the S.S. Anne and get HM01 (Cut) from the captain.
Defeat Lt. Surge at the Vermilion City Gym (Electric; Ground moves are strong). A small tree blocks the gym entrance.
Go back to Cerulean, east via Route 9 to Rock Tunnel (Route 10), and through it south to Lavender Town.
Go west from Lavender Town via Route 8 and the Underground Path to Celadon City.
Defeat Erika at the Celadon City Gym (Grass; Fire, Ice, Flying moves are strong).

events.say: Professor Oak stops you in the tall grass and walks you to his lab.
The S.S. Anne sets sail as you leave; you watch it go from the dock and walk into the city.
